notes.title: - The GENESIS Update Is Live -
notes.content:
Hello all,

The GENESIS update adds long awaited gear and mods to the game, many of which were suggested by our community. As always, a bunch of bug fixes and balance changes are included. Here are the highlights:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33285787/d877f983a3fbccf22e3890b276f935c11f0c6399.jpg[/img]

[b]Changelog Updated[/b] : [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/858210/discussions/0/3658515990056189069/]Click here for the full patch notes.[/url]

[h2]New Gear[/h2]
[h3]Weapon: Thermal Lance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Charge up and sustain a focused lance of heat to burn targets and make them vulnerable to further damage
[*] While sustaining Thermal Lance, you also fire twisting sparks that are affected by your projectile mods
[*] Thermal Lance and its sparks ignite targets for 120 burning damage /s
[*] Damage from Thermal Lance and its sparks apply vulnerability to targets
[*] Vulnerability increases the damage targets take from all sources. After targets stop receiving vulnerability for one second, the effect falls off over time
[*] -35% thrust and -50% rotation speed while charging
[*] Damage: Thermal Lance damage scales with its charge level
[*] Spark damage: 8
[*] Spark count: 1
[*] Spark rate of fire: 7.5 /s
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33285787/14090b8db496f4f9ca2d962fbd0bd9c898445f43.jpg[/img]


[h3]Shield: Shockwave[/h3]
[list]
[*] Shockwave releases waves that ebb and flow, pushing targets and projectiles around it
[*] When your shields reset after its cooldown, Shockwave releases a forceful wave which deals 120 damage and applies +20% vulnerability to targets it hits
[*] Shields: 60
[*] Cooldown: 7 seconds
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33285787/aa844b0844a8bf0cb30e0b0bce288748920e2f3d.jpg[/img]


[h3]Body: Carrier[/h3]
[list]
[*] You automatically assemble and deploy Swarm Constructs, which apply vulnerability to targets
[*] While a damaged shield protects you, a portion of your Swarm Constructs are assigned to recover your shields
[*] While your shield is down or you have no shield, Swarm Constructs gain increased movement speed and rate of fire
[*] -10% rate of fire
[*] Hull: 110
[*] Thrust: 75
[*] Swarm Constructs: Type: Basic construct. Rarely created as standard or advanced constructs with improved abilities
[*] Construct limit: 4 + 1 for every 2 of your levels
[*] Hull: 8 Damage: 5. Applies 0.25% vulnerability
[*] Rate of fire: 1.5 /s Assembly time: 1 second
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33285787/65f315986a2f57bc34d71159c7217b7afc5bb25f.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Super Mods[/h2]
[h3]Charged Mines[/h3]
[list]
[*] Your mines charge your weapon at 100% of your charge rate
[*] Charged Shot no longer applies to you
[*] -25% mine trigger radius
[*] Your mines constantly take 2 damage /s
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33285787/bc1a71158f3e817473bba9db49e7c8e08aa997ed.jpg[/img]

[h3]Mortar[/h3]
[list]
[*] Your mines are deployed at high velocity, in your firing direction(s), when you fire
[*] Your mines detonate at low velocity instead of detonating within a trigger radius
-20% mine damage and mine effect
[*] If you fire with no mines assembled, a mine is deployed and 15% + 5 of your current hull and shields are removed. This removal cannot be mitigated, but also can not reduce hull or shields below 1
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33285787/acef814d1d203eef098a12a723336be210f622b1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Reworked Mods[/h2]
[h3]Loaded Mines[/h3]
[list]
[*] On detonation, your mines fire your weapon in a radial spread
[*] The number of weapon instances produced by Loaded Mines is determined by your rate of fire and projectile count
[*] For weapons that charge innately, your mines charge your weapon at 75% of your charge rate. Additionally, they constantly take 2 damage /s
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33285787/a83d8f3a37353954d1ad04c6460c802f3bb6f3b3.jpg[/img]

[h3]Minefield[/h3]
[list]
[*] Your mines are deployed all at once in a cluster
[*] +3 mine construct limit
[*] +50% mine assembly speed
[*] -50% mine maximum hull
[*] -25% mine damage, total mine effect, and mine trigger radius
[*] Your mines cause a chain reaction when they detonate
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33285787/49e2a7ba50bd0b3aefa3b7bde777393c6cf38974.jpg[/img]

[h2]Other Notable Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Loaded Mines and Retribution have switched places on the tree, allowing mine builds to have access to this key mod earlier
[*] Auto Mines has been replaced by Minefield
[*] Interceptor Allies can now properly utilize innately charging weapons (Vortex and Thermal Lance)
[*] New battle BGM added: Superlumen and Superlumen (Warped), for Endless and Wild Metamorphosis, respectively
[*] Rancor has been reworked. It now has quite an explosive effect when triggered (roughly 5 times its previous magnitude), but wears off over time
[*] Dozens of bug fixes and minor adjustments
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33285787/2a1c4727fbc92d2b6340e8500015f4b96c8f8435.jpg[/img]

We hope everyone enjoys the new features!  Much more on the way.  In the meantime, keep on drifting and stay safe & sane! :)

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

notes.title: - The FISSION Update Is Live -
notes.content:
[b]NOVA DRIFT: FISSION[/b]
v0.24.4
[i]November 16, 2019[/i]

Nova Drift [b]FISSION[/b] brings additional polish, balance, and quality-of-life changes to Nova Drift, along with introducing some new Body Gear and build archetypes. Older, underutilized upgrades have been given new artwork and overhauls. FISSION also introduces some wave and scaling changes which set the stage for the upcoming enemy and boss rework.

[b]Highlights:[/b]

Harnessing mysterious cosmic powers, the Stealth body gear has been divided into two separate bodies: The Spectre and the Firefly.

The [b]Spectre[/b] body gear represents the stealth aspect of the original Stealth body. It is able to cloak faster and enjoys up to a +200% weapon damage buff when fully cloaked. It is able to move at low speeds without breaking cloak and can apply a partial damage buff while partially cloaked. Additionally, enemies have been given more intelligent reactions to a stealthed target...

The [b]Firefly[/b] body gear represents the speed, thruster burn, and self-damage resistant aspects of the original Stealth body. Its thrusters are now larger, deal more damage, are more wide-spread, and have unique artwork.

The [b]Split Shot[/b] weapon has been reworked. It has been given new visual effects and animations and its damage and spread has been increased. Additionally, the weapon now innately deals 50% splash damage on hit to targets behind its point of impact.

Added a new recursive common Wild Mod: [b]Masochism[/b]. Masochism grants +8% self-damage resistance, but increases damage taken from enemies by 4%. It also provides a stackable "Adrenal Module-like effect", providing up to +15% increased global damage while at death's door.

Reflexive Shields, Defiance, Hypermetabolism, Regenerative Shields, and Celestial Lance have been reworked or upgraded. Myriad other balance adjustments and minor features have been added!

Introduced the [b]Combat Log[/b] to the game!

Added support for directional steering!

Waves and enemy scaling have been reworked. Progression is smoother now, with very high waves being far less chaotic (but still difficult!) Enemies are more powerful, but less numerous, allowing more strategic builds to compete in the late-game alongside the usual contenders.

Full details on the update are available here:
[url=https://blog.novadrift.io/patch-notes/]https://blog.novadrift.io/patch-notes/[/url]

notes.content:
We've successfully migrated the game from GameMaker Studio to GameMaker 2! This is a huge leap forward in stability, portability, support, and performance. Additionally, in future builds, we can compile to Linux and OSX using the native compiler, and its a step closer to console ports!

[b]This is a big update! You can read the full change log here: [url=https://blog.novadrift.io/patch-notes/]0.20.11 Patch Notes[/url][/b]

This patch levels the playing field. The more overpowered interactions have been addressed or redesigned outright, allowing for a far greater variety of builds to be competitive. Weaker mechanics have received some love. Here are some of the highlights: 
- Sweeping construct balance changes
- A complete overhaul of the Research ship body, with a new unique ability
- Blast Radius and Splinter Shot overhauls
- Corrosion rework
- Settings for analog and digital control styles
- A great deal of performance optimizations

I'm excited to say that with the engine migration out of the way, I'm able to focus fully on creating new content! We've got some exciting new things coming up, and not only what's on the [url=https://blog.novadrift.io/nova-drift-2019-roadmap/]roadmap[/url]. There's also [url=https://blog.novadrift.io/upcoming-changes-to-upgrades/]this![/url]

Naturally, with an engine transition comes different problems for different hardware configurations and software. I can say with confidence that more people are now able to play on this version than than before, but some did encounter new problems. Most of them have easy solutions, such as restarting, disabling third party software, white listing on antiviruses, or reinstalling. Problems with OBS can be solved through OBS configuration settings. Please contact Chimeric directly with any problems:

Email: chimericgames@gmail.com

Or chat with me here: [url= https://discord.gg/Zp2MkPJ]Discord[/url]

Thanks for your continued support! And HAVE FUN!
Best,
Chimeric

notes.title: The First Major Update (0.19.2) Is Live! Quality-Of-Life / Balance / Construct Enhancements
notes.content:
Hello all,

We hope everyone has been enjoying the game so far.  We've listened to your feedback (there was a lot of it!) and have put together the first major update to the game, which should be waiting for you in the main branch... you might have to restart Steam to get it.

There are a few ways you learn about the updates.  If you just want a summary, read below or [url=https://twitter.com/NovaDriftGame/status/1116342729707941893] check this big tweet [/url].  Bonus points for RT'ing to boost the signal!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/858210/discussions/0/3658515990056189069]You can read the entire report / patch notes here.[/url]

This update focuses on quality-of-life changes, balance, and raising the power level of several formerly uncompetitive loadouts such as engineer and architect construct builds, shielded construct builds, and Siege Weaponry / Saturation Fire builds.

Construct AI has been given quite a few advancements, including the ability to lead their targets, dodge hazards, and multitask while repositioning. They're generally more graceful and well positioned. These changes, combined with the addition of level-scaled assembly time, have given constructs far greater sustain in late waves. Buffs have also been given to Apex Machinery and Shielded Constructs, which is now quite viable defensively, compared to other defensive set ups. 

Self-Damage systems such as Siege Weaponry, Saturation Fire, and Antimatter Rounds have been rebalanced and made more dynamic. Siege Weaponry no longer damages you on the first strike, provides more benefit up front, and spools up smoothly. Saturation Fire now allows the full range of calibrate's affects and works with more set ups. If you've ever wanted to convert Pulse into a long range auto-shotgun, now you can!

Additionally, there are quite a few new small features: The Stealth body gets bonus damage when breaking stealth, the game has been zoomed out, a new music track has been added, burn damage numbers can be shown, more statistics are displayed, and many bugs have been fixed along with a number of sizable optimizations. For Streamers with wide aspect monitors, windowed mode is now a fixed 16:9, with more dynamic options to come.

The next major update will feature new content!

Also, please consider RT'ing [url=https://twitter.com/NovaDriftGame/status/1110914804535816192] the original launch announcement[/url] if you have not yet.

Finally, [url=https://discord.gg/Zp2MkPJ]join our discord community![/url]  This is the most direct way to chat with other players and submit feedback, bug reports and feature requests.

Keep on drifting….
[I]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/I]

notes.title: New Dev Blog Entry - Future Content: WILD METAMORPHOSIS
notes.content:
From Chimeric, Lead Dev:

"Interestingly, there is some discourse over how Nova Drift should be classified. I see people often refer to it as a "rogue-like" or "rogue-lite". Or perhaps it's an action-rpg with some non-deterministic elements. With this decade's glorious panoply of indie treasures, the definitions have become increasingly blurred. The good news is that I believe Nova Drift is in a good position to provide both experiences, thanks its modular challenge modes.

Where I'm going with this: Some people want to play Nova Drift and be able to create a deterministic build every run. Others want there to be greater limitation, such that they are required to adapt, overcome, and build on their toes. I'm keen to provide that extra "roguelite" element for those that want it. And so, I have concocted... Wild Metamorphosis: Challenge Mode Unlocked!"

[URL]https://blog.novadrift.io/wild-metamorphosis/[/URL]
